thought: Phase 3: the analyzers found five results. Checking them by rule.

args.title: Decoupling capacitor C13 is far from the radio supply pin
args.what: C13 sits 5.2 mm from the U3 supply pin, over the 3 mm limit.
args.why_it_matters: A long loop weakens decoupling and can add noise on the radio supply.
args.recommendation: Move C13 closer to the U3 supply pin in your layout tool.

args.title: Ground copper sits inside the antenna clearance zone
args.what: A ground pour covers 38 mm2 of the antenna clearance zone.
args.why_it_matters: Copper next to a printed antenna detunes it and lowers radiated power.
args.recommendation: Review the ground pour next to the antenna feed and keep the clearance zone empty.

args.reason: A shallow corner on a slow signal track does not matter here.

args.title: Crystal load capacitors look unbalanced
args.what: The two crystal load capacitors do not appear to be placed symmetrically around Y1.
args.why_it_matters: Unbalanced load capacitors can pull the clock frequency.
args.recommendation: Check the crystal load capacitor placement against the datasheet layout.
